about: Only for the end-to-end build (VITE_E2E_FIXTURES=1; veilcore/bitcoin/stamp-check.ts). The browser tests pin real mainnet block 438 and serve a practice block 439 mined on top of it at Bitcoin's minimum difficulty (nBits 0x1d00ffff), whose merkle root is SHA-256 of the e2e test batch's root (veilcore/chain/fixtures/anchor-indexer.json). Block 439 is not Bitcoin's block 439. Mined once for these tests.
